kernel void multiply(
    const device float* lhs
        [[buffer(0)]],

    const device float* rhs
        [[buffer(1)]],

    device float* output
        [[buffer(2)]],

    uint id
        [[thread_position_in_grid]])
{
    output[id] =
        lhs[id] *
        rhs[id];
}

kernel void reduce(
    const device float* input
        [[buffer(0)]],

    device float* output
        [[buffer(1)]],

    uint local
        [[thread_index_in_threadgroup]],

    uint group
        [[threadgroup_position_in_grid]])
{
    threadgroup float
        scratch[256];

    scratch[local] =
        input[
            group * 256 +
            local];

    threadgroup_barrier(
        mem_flags::mem_threadgroup);

    ...
}
